text_annotations.text: RP2040 controller + MSPM0G3507 target + MS9280 capture ADC
Shunt -> AC differential amplifier -> 10-bit ADC -> RP2040 PIO/DMA -> USB

All target-facing GPIO must be high-impedance while target power is off.
Use open-drain reset behavior. Keep acquisition-critical code in SRAM.

C1-C6: IOVDD pins 1/10/22/33/42/49. C7/C8: DVDD pins 23/50.
C9 USB_VDD; C10 ADC_AVDD. C27 VREG_IN; C28 VREG_OUT.
Place each capacitor at its corresponding supply pin.

IOVDD: pins 1/10/22/33/42/49 share the shown pin.
All six connect to +3V3; C2 decouples pin 10.

Use generic SPI boot2 first; validate Puya QE/quad commands.
BOOTSEL shorts flash CS through 1k during reset/boot.

R15/R16/R48: place at RP2040 source pins.
{TARGET_LINK} -> target; {ADC_CAPTURE} <- ADC.

Kelvin sense R19 on TARGET side, sheet 8. 1 ohm: 1 mA change -> 10 mV.
Nominal ADC range: +/-50 mA around the settled baseline. Not a DC ammeter.

R46/C45 are parallel OUT-to-IN- feedback. R47/C46 are parallel IN+-to-1V bias.
Matched 200R/2k 0.1% ratios; C45/C46 paired 7p5 C0G.
1u coupling: 796 Hz high-pass. Feedback RC: 10.6 MHz; R27/C44: 179 MHz.
Whole-path target ~5 MHz including finite op-amp GBW; estimate, not measured.
Place feedback parts at U9; keep both input arms short and matched.
Validate noise, input clamping, common-mode rejection and recovery after a glitch.

MODE = AVDD/2. REFSENSE = VREF: 1 V span.
REFTS = REFBS = VREF: nominal AIN 0.5-1.5 V.

DATA BUS -> RP2040 (sheet 3)
D0..D9 -> GPIO0..GPIO9
OTR -> GPIO10; STBY -> GPIO12

Place R5-R14 near ADC outputs.
Start capture at 10 MS/s.
35 MS/s is the ADC rating;
system timing needs validation.

Use a continuous ground plane. Route the ADC digital return away from AIN and
the reference network. Put every bypass capacitor at its corresponding supply pin.

HF bypass PA6/pin10: 4-48 MHz. LF bypass PA4/pin8: nominal 32.768 kHz.
R16/R48 are on sheet 3; place physically at RP2040 GPIO24/GPIO25.
Firmware selects external clocks after internal-clock boot.
For BSL entry, assert TP11 to target VDD during reset; review TI security errata.
TARGET SUPPLY / CORE CAP / RESET BIAS
BSL: RP GPIO27 via R54; R34 keeps normal boot selected.
SPI0 peripheral; GPIO header on sheet 7

U4 supplies board 3.3 V. RP2040 retains its internal core regulator.
Check LDO temperature and VBUS droop at maximum measured load.
USB-C / ESD / FUSED POWER ENTRY / 3.3 V SUPPLY

U7 VDD must remain >= 4.5 V for specified timing.
Keep pulse return short; R19 is not rated for a sustained short.

QOD tied to VOUT: discharge enabled.
Switched 3.3 V crosses J3/J4 pin 19.
R19 shunt is on TARGET side, sheet 8.

top_issues.summary: JP2 (Jumper_3_Open) — open by default, between TARGET_VDD_SENSE ↔ /d17160bd-daf5-5533-9d68-e15229d9d939/TARGET_GLITCH_OUT
